name: cal-08-day-drum
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — day drum + white letter inlay, FULL SIZE. Split out of the failed cal-03, which paired this with the month drum; see cal-01 for why the pairing was abandoned and why brim is now set explicitly instead of auto_brim. day.stl has 5691mm2 of contact standing 40mm tall (ratio 142) — better than month's 79 but still well under date10's 286, which is the only ratio in this build proven to hold without a brim. Treat as at risk, not safe. THIS PLATE CARRIES THE ONLY OFF-CENTRE PAIR IN THE SET: letter bbox-centre delta [-1.161, +0.012], z_offset 1.809. The -1.161 is real and verified, not a slip — day-letter spans 87.48mm in X against the drum's 90.00 because the day-name ring is asymmetric, which drags its bbox centre off axis. Checked radially: placed as specced the letters form a clean annulus r43.00-44.90 (spread 1.90, matching month-letter's 42.89-45.01 reference); with the sign flipped they smear to r40.91-47.22 (spread 6.32), sunk into the drum on one side and floating off it on the other. Do not tidy it to zero — it looks correct in preview either way. Expect the two-colour band near layer 9. A blank stretch in the lettering is by design, not a missing glyph. FILAMENT: slot 1 black PLA MATTE, slot 2 white PLA BASIC, ams_mapping 2,0.
